description: This file defines a PySide6 GUI dialog class 'ModifiersList' for selecting modifiers in the BORIS behavioral observation software. It manages UI elements, user interactions, and retrieval of selected modifiers, supporting single, multi, and numeric types.

classes.name: ModifiersList
classes.description: A dialog for selecting behavior modifiers, supporting multiple selection types and user interaction handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, sets up UI components, and populates modifier options based on provided data.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Handles key press events for dialog interaction, including navigation and selection via keyboard.

methods.name: get_modifiers
methods.description: Retrieves the selected modifiers from the UI components.

methods.name: pbOK_clicked
methods.description: Validates numeric input and confirms selection when OK button is pressed.
